LicenseVoucher.title: LicenseVoucher
LicenseVoucher.description: Publicly redeemable Pro license voucher without PII, created exclusively by the application owner for offline buyers.

planLabel.description: Display label for the offline Pro package duration.

durationDays.description: Number of active Pro days granted upon redemption.

creatorUid.description: UID of the owner admin who generated the voucher.

redeemedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who redeemed the voucher, or empty string when unredeemed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was last updated.

AdminBuyerRecord.title: AdminBuyerRecord
AdminBuyerRecord.description: Strictly isolated offline buyer PII and payment notes accessible only to the owner admin.

voucherCode.description: Matching voucher code ID in licenseVouchers.

buyerName.description: Offline buyer name recorded by the owner.

buyerContact.description: Offline buyer WhatsApp or contact note.

paymentNote.description: Offline transaction note (e.g. cash, bank transfer).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the buyer record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the buyer record was updated.

/licenseVouchers/{voucherId}.description: Stores offline Pro activation codes without PII.

/adminBuyerRecords/{voucherId}.description: Stores isolated offline buyer PII and payment records accessible strictly to the owner.
